title: Detached/undocked DevTools is a blank/empty window
body: ### Preflight Checklist - [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project. - [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to. - [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a bug report that matches the one I want to file, without success. ### Electron Version 43.1.1 ### What operating system(s) are you using? macOS ### Operating System Version macOS Sonoma 14.7.3 ### What arch are you using? arm64 (including Apple Silicon) ### Last Known Working Electron version 39.8.10 ### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome? I don't know how to test ### Expected Behavior Opening dev tools in `detach` or `undock` mode should show dev tools. ### Actual Behavior On any electron version newer than 39.8.10, dev tools in detach/undocked mode is a blank/empty window, nothing loads. Only downgrading to electron 39.8.10 fixes it. ### Testcase Gist URL _No response_ ### Additional Information Worth noting: This is happening for a frameless transparent window. Opening it in any mode besides `detach` or `undocked` works, but is not usable in this case (and overlay window w/ click-through transparency). Also worth noting: disabling all extensions does not fix it either. Screenshot of 39.8.10 electron:
